{{Quote|It's all over now. Paal's gone raving mad. He accused Bekis of trying to kill him at the last campsite and shot him.|One of Sylas Wilkes's men|<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|Into the Dune Sea|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Bekis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal in the employ of [[Sylas Wilkes]] who was one of fifteen men tasked with guarding a shipment of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and a [[Tulak Hord's artifact (Tatooine)|Sith artifact]] for their boss on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. However, the artifact drove the group mad, and they fled into the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] with the blasters and the artifacts. As the artifact's influence over them grew, they were picked off one by one by either the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] or themselves. Bekis, [[Paal]], and another man were among the last survivors at one point, but an insane Paal accused Bekis of trying to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him and then shot him.<ref name="SWTOR" />
